tennessee/nashville.title: Nashville Farmers Markets - {count} Markets, Days and Hours
tennessee/nashville.description: {count} farmers markets in Nashville, TN with days, hours and parking. Nashville Farmers' Market is open Friday-Sunday and doubles SNAP up to $100.

tips.label: Year-round
tips.text: The farm sheds at Nashville Farmers' Market run Friday-Sunday all year: 9am-2pm March-October and 10am-2pm November-February.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Nashville Farmers' Market has free 2-hour parking on site and along 7th Ave. State government lots nearby are free on Saturdays and Sundays.

tips.label: By bus
tips.text: WeGo buses stop in front of Nashville Farmers' Market on Rosa L. Parks Blvd.

tips.label: SNAP doubled
tips.text: Fresh Bucks at Nashville Farmers' Market matches SNAP $1 for $1, up to $100, at the info booth in Farm Shed 1 on weekends from 10am-2pm.

tips.label: Winter Saturdays
tips.text: Richland Park Farmers' Market runs every Saturday, rain or shine: 9am-12pm April-December and 10am-12pm January-March.

tips.label: Late season
tips.text: East Nashville Farmers' Market keeps going on Tuesdays through December 22, 2026, from 3:30pm-6pm, with free parking on site.

faqs.question: Is the Market House at Nashville Farmers' Market open every day?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Market House building is open daily from 8am-8pm, though each restaurant and shop inside sets its own hours.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to a Nashville farmers market?
faqs.answer: East Nashville Farmers' Market welcomes pets, but asks that dogs wear foot protection on hot summer asphalt.

faqs.question: Where is the East Nashville Farmers' Market?
faqs.answer: At 5th and Woodland (511 Woodland Street). Extra free lots are at 6th and Main St and at First Church of the Nazarene across the street.

faqs.question: How big is Richland Park Farmers' Market?
faqs.answer: It has 80+ vendors in peak season, from farmers and bakers to cheese makers, chefs and food entrepreneurs.

ohio/columbus.title: Columbus, OH Farmers Markets: Saturday and Holiday Markets
ohio/columbus.description: Columbus, OH farmers markets with days and hours. German Village and Clintonville run Saturdays through Nov 21, then Clintonville moves indoors in December.

tips.label: Late season
tips.text: German Village (Saturdays 9am-1pm, 555 S Third St) and Clintonville (Saturdays 9am-12pm) both run through November 21, 2026.

tips.label: Holiday market
tips.text: Clintonville's Holiday Market moves inside North Broadway United Methodist Church on Saturdays December 5, 12 and 19, from 9am-1pm.

tips.label: SNAP match
tips.text: Clintonville Farmers Market matches SNAP $1 for $1, up to $25, on your Ohio Direction Card (EBT). WIC farmers market coupons are welcome too.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Clintonville Farmers Market (3535 N High St) has free parking at Columbus Mennonite Church and on side streets, plus a free bike corral on Orchard Ln.

tips.label: Produce Perks
tips.text: The Conservatory Farmers Market at Franklin Park Conservatory takes EBT and adds Produce Perks dollars for fresh produce. It runs Wednesdays, June-September.

tips.label: Pearl Market
tips.text: Pearl Market in the Gay Street District has ended after 26 years. Downtown's weekday market is now Thursdays 11am-2pm at Columbus Commons (160 S High St).

faqs.question: Are there farmers markets on weekday evenings in Columbus?
faqs.answer: In summer, yes. Bronzeville Growers Market runs Thursdays 3pm-6pm at 925 Mt Vernon Ave (July 2-Sept 24), and Franklin Park Conservatory hosts a market on Wednesdays 3:30pm-6:30pm (June 3-Sept 16).

faqs.question: Is there a farmers market on the West Side of Columbus?
faqs.answer: Westgate Farmers Market sets up at 2925 W Broad St on the 1st and 3rd Saturdays of each month, June through October, from 9am-12pm.

minnesota/minneapolis.title: Minneapolis Farmers Markets: Winter Markets, Days and Hours
minnesota/minneapolis.description: {count} farmers markets in Minneapolis, MN with days and hours. Mill City and Northeast move indoors for winter, and the Lyndale market runs May-Oct, Wed-Sun.

tips.label: Biggest market
tips.text: The Minneapolis Farmers Market at 312 E Lyndale Ave N runs May 2-Oct 31 in 2026: Wednesday-Friday 7am-1pm, Saturday and Sunday 6am-1pm.

tips.label: Winter
tips.text: Mill City's last outdoor market is Oct 31. From Nov 7 it moves inside the Mill City Museum on the 1st and 3rd Saturdays, 9am-1pm, through April. Entry is free.

tips.label: Holiday season
tips.text: Mill City's indoor markets before the holidays fall on Nov 7, Nov 21, Dec 5 and Dec 19. There is no market on Saturday, Jan 2.

tips.label: Southwest winter
tips.text: Neighborhood Roots runs winter markets indoors at Bachman's, 6010 Lyndale Ave S, 10am-1pm on Nov 14, 2026, then Jan 9, Feb 6 and Mar 13, 2027.

tips.label: SNAP match
tips.text: At Mill City's Info Booth, SNAP/EBT is triple matched year-round: buy $10 in tokens and get $40 to spend.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Mill City: the Mill Quarter ramp across the street has a $3 Saturday special (in before 10am, out by 1pm). The US Bank Stadium light rail stop is two blocks away.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to Mill City Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: Outdoors, leashed dogs (6 feet or shorter) are welcome in the open Chicago Mall between the Guthrie and the museum, but not under the covered Train Shed. Dogs are not allowed at the indoor winter market.

faqs.question: Is there a winter farmers market in Northeast Minneapolis?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Northeast Minneapolis Farmers Market meets the first Saturday of each month, November through April, 10am-1pm at East Side Neighborhood Services, 1700 2nd St NE.

faqs.question: How old is the Minneapolis Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: It started in 1876 at First Street and Hennepin Avenue. The Lyndale market, with its three red sheds, opened in 1937 and now has 170 stalls shared by more than 100 vendors.

faqs.question: Does the Minneapolis Farmers Market on Lyndale take EBT?
faqs.answer: Yes, in season. Swipe your card at the EBT booth for tokens, and Market Bucks match SNAP spending dollar for dollar, up to $10 per visit.
